item.title: OpenAI says it solved Navier-Stokes Millennium problem; researchers allege unfair tactics
item.description: OpenAI said Tuesday that it has found a solution to the Navier-Stokes existence and smoothness problem, an open mathematical question that has remained unsolved for roughly 90 years and is one of the seven Millennium Prize Problems, each carrying a $1 million bounty from the Clay Mathematics…

item.title: Shelton beats Alcaraz in latest-ever US Open finish to reach semifinals
item.description: Ben Shelton outlasted defending champion Carlos Alcaraz in a five-set quarterfinal thriller that ended at 3:34 a.m. local time Wednesday, the latest finish in US Open history. The eighth-seeded American won 6-7 (5-7), 6-1, 6-3, 1-6, 7-6 (10-7) in four hours, 28 minutes on Arthur Ashe Stadium, after…
